title: one cta per screen
rule: One Call to Action per screen — CTA usually appears alone, command-like (landing/welcome); may be as wide as its parent. Distinct from one-primary-in-a-group.
pass_when: Landing/welcome (command-like) screen has one CTA, usually alone; may span its parent.
fail_when: Multiple CTAs on that landing/welcome screen.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: One invented global cap vs group / page / section; `actions.buttons.one_primary` as a delete of this named CTA-per-screen row.
